subject.title: feat: bound reads from open file descriptors

question: Should fs-safe ship public bounded descriptor-read helpers together with a change that treats pinned-write `fsync` `EPERM` as success?
rationale: The read helpers establish a new public advanced API, while suppressing `EPERM` changes an observable write/durability failure contract; tests alone cannot choose the intended compatibility policy.

options.title: Split the durability change
options.body: Approve the bounded-read API after proof, but defer the `EPERM` suppression to a separately reviewed compatibility decision.

options.title: Approve both contracts
options.body: Accept the public helpers and document that `EPERM` synchronization failures are best effort on supported filesystems.

recommendation.title: Split the durability change
recommendation.body: Approve the bounded-read API after proof, but defer the `EPERM` suppression to a separately reviewed compatibility decision.

likelyOwner.reason: The available branch history and stated downstream use case tie steipete most directly to explaining the intended API and compatibility contract.
